competitions.name: Number Sense
competitions.note: A timed mental-math contest: 80 questions in 10 minutes, no scratch work. Many schools run it; the weekly warm-up builds the speed it rewards.

competitions.name: Bebras
competitions.note: An international computing and logical thinking challenge held online. Not sat this year; past problems are used for practice.

competitions.name: MOEMS
competitions.note: A monthly math olympiad with a new set of problems each session. Not sat this year; past problems are used for practice.

competitions.name: Math Kangaroo
competitions.note: An international multiple choice math competition organised by grade level. Not sat this year; past problems are used for practice.

competitions.name: AMC 8
competitions.note: A middle school math competition that opens once the skills track reaches algebra. Sat once, January 2027.

competitions.name: MATHCOUNTS
competitions.note: A team and individual math competition that runs through local and state rounds. Not sat this year; past problems are used for practice.

competitions.name: USACO Bronze
competitions.note: An online programming contest that opens once the build track reaches Python. Not sat this year; past problems are used for practice.
